about-description: I’m originally from the south of Brazil and I’m now based in Paris. In the world of tattooing, my biggest passion is botany. I believe that plant and flower tattoos go far beyond aesthetics: they can be a tribute to someone we love or a way to illustrate our own journey. Thinking about getting a tattoo in this style but not sure what to choose yet? Send me a message on WhatsApp — I’ll be happy to help you.
studio-description: Located within a Parisian esthetic center, the studio is a clean and serene space. Here, you can expect a private setting for individualized tattoo experiences. It’s a tranquil environment where you can fully immerse yourself in the tattoo process.
